project_type: React SPA with Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS
build_system: Vite 6 with TypeScript compilation, path alias @ -> src/
test_framework: No test framework configured - only linting via eslint
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm install in dashboard/. 2. Run npm run build to verify TypeScript compilation and Vite build succeed with no errors.
environment_constraints: npm packages can be installed. No test runner configured, so verification is via successful tsc + vite build. tsconfig has strict mode with noUnusedLocals and noUnusedParameters.
contribution_requirements: Standard React/TS patterns. Use @ alias for imports. Use Tailwind CSS for styling. Use lucide-react for icons. Use recharts for charts.
key_patterns: Components use named exports. Pages are in src/pages/. Layout wraps all routes via Outlet. Common UI components in src/components/common/. Charts in src/components/charts/. Config values in src/config.ts and src/config/. Hooks in src/hooks/. API layer in src/api/. Types in src/types/.
directory_structure: dashboard/src/: App.tsx (router), main.tsx (entry), index.css (tailwind base), config.ts (company ID). Components: layout/ (Layout, Sidebar, Header, Breadcrumb), common/ (Card, Button, Badge, etc.), charts/ (CostChart, TaskPieChart, PerformanceChart), activity/ (ActivityFeed, ActivityItem), office/ (OfficeCanvas, FloorPlan, Room, etc.). Pages: Dashboard, Office, Agents, Tasks, etc. Types: agent.ts, task.ts, office.ts, common.ts, etc.
